Data Science Concentration
The Department offers a concentration in Data Science for the Ph.D. in Statistics. This concentration will allow students to focus on specific areas in statistics related to data science.
COURSE REQUIREMENTS - 12 hours
Students will earn a concentration in Data Science by taking any 4 of the following courses:
STA 5363 Advanced Data Driven Methods
STA 6376 Computational Statistics II
STA 6380 Modern Trends in Data Science Computing
CSI 5325 Introduction to Machine Learning
ELC 5365 Introduction to Deep Learning
ECO 5351 Data Science I
CSI 5357 Cloud Learning
Students in the program must also complete the Ph.D. in Statistics to be awarded the concentration in Data Science upon graduation.
